description: Compare 2 to 5 social accounts side by side (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Bluesky, mixed): followers, engagement rate, avg likes/comments/views, posting cadence, 30-day growth, leaders per metric and rankings. Use for competitor tracking or picking between creators: pass profiles [{platform, handle}] for 2-5 accounts, any mix of platforms. Returns leaders {followers, engagementRate, avgViews, postsPerWeek}, ranking {followers, engagementRate}, a one-line summary and profiles[] with the numbers per account. An account that cannot be fetched is reported inline; the call fails (not charged) only when none can be fetched. Price: $0.05 USDC per call (x402 on Base); not charged if the call fails.

maxAgeHours.description: Oldest data you accept per account, 1-720 hours (default 72; Bluesky 6)

profiles.description: 2 to 5 accounts, any mix of platforms

name: social_compare

leaders.description: Top account per metric; null when fewer than two have the number

error.description: Set instead of the numbers when this account could not be fetched

growth30d.description: Follower change over about 30 days; null without enough history

title: Compare social accounts
